name: Battle Born Powersports
note: Self-guided UTV rental at the Johnson Lane OHV area, Minden NV. The FAQ settles the scope question explicitly: 'We are currently offering a self guided experience' — so despite the site using the word 'Tours' in page taglines, the customer takes the machine independently and this is real inventory. Fleet is organised entirely by seat count (2/4/6), which is exactly what the seat_count attribute exists for. Rentals are sold in roughly 2-hour and 4-hour blocks; only a 'STARTING AT $299' figure is published and the site does not say which machine or block it applies to, so no price tier is asserted. Damage deposit is $3,000 per machine.

items.name: 2-Seater UTV Rental
items.description: Self-guided trail rental sold in approximately 2-hour and 4-hour blocks. The site publishes only a fleet-wide 'starting at $299' figure without stating which machine or duration it covers, so no rate is recorded. $3,000 damage deposit per machine, held on a card at checkout; cash not accepted.

items.name: 4-Seater UTV Rental
items.description: Full-door 4-seat trail machine, described by the operator as its most balanced trail vehicle. Self-guided, 2-hour and 4-hour blocks. $3,000 damage deposit per machine.

items.name: 6-Seater UTV Rental
items.description: Largest machine in the fleet, for groups. Self-guided, 2-hour and 4-hour blocks. $3,000 damage deposit per machine.

name: Rolling Freedom Motorcycles & Lake Tahoe Slingshots
note: Stateline NV shop renting Harley-Davidson, Indian, Triumph, Honda and KTM motorcycles through a first-party booking storefront at rentals.rolltahoe.com (Ski Rental Systems platform — first-party inventory per the storefront rule). Rates sit behind the booking widget and are not published as static text, so items carry null prices. Confirmed booking conditions: motorcycle 'M' endorsement required, daily rentals include 400 miles, 3+ day rentals are unlimited mileage, and insurance is required at $35.00/day. NOTE: the operator also rents Polaris Slingshots, Can-Am Spyders and Honda Ruckus mopeds — see the taxonomy proposal logged in 00_general §11; only the Spyder is filed here.

items.name: Harley-Davidson Street Glide
items.description: Touring bagger. Requires a motorcycle M endorsement. Daily rentals include 400 miles; 3-or-more-day rentals are unlimited mileage. Rate is only shown inside the booking widget.

items.name: Harley-Davidson Road Glide
items.description: Touring bagger. M endorsement required; 400 miles included daily, unlimited at 3+ days.

items.name: Harley-Davidson Heritage Softail
items.description: Cruiser. M endorsement required; 400 miles included daily, unlimited at 3+ days.

items.name: Indian Scout Sixty
items.description: Mid-size cruiser, an approachable option in the fleet. M endorsement required.

items.name: Triumph Tiger
items.description: Street-plated adventure/touring bike. M endorsement required.

items.name: KTM 890 Adventure R
items.description: Street-plated dual-sport. Filed as adventure_moto rather than off_road because it is plated — the dividing line is plates, not terrain.

items.name: Honda Rebel 500 ABS
items.description: Entry-level cruiser, the most beginner-friendly bike in the fleet. M endorsement still required.

items.name: Can-Am Spyder 900
items.description: Three-wheeled roadster listed by the operator under motorcycle rentals. Filed as street_moto because it is a plated on-road motorcycle, but the form factor is not a two-wheeler — see the autocycle taxonomy proposal in 00_general §11.

name: Rolling Freedom Motorcycles & Lake Tahoe Slingshots
note: One unplated competition dirt bike in an otherwise street-focused fleet.

items.name: KTM 500 EXC-F
items.description: High-performance enduro. Listed by the operator alongside its motorcycles; filed as off_road/dirt_bike. If the shop plates this unit as a dual-sport it would move to motorcycles/adventure_moto — the storefront does not say, so the more conservative off-road placement is used.

name: Rolling Freedom Motorcycles & Lake Tahoe Slingshots
note: Moto-style fat-tire electric bikes, explicitly marketed as requiring no special licence. Deliberately filed with gear_type ebike rather than fat_ebike: these are summer cruising e-bikes, not winter snow bikes, and fat_ebike drives the winter fat_bike activity.

items.name: Juiced Scorpion Electric Bike
items.description: Moto-style fat-tire electric bike. The operator states no specialised licence is required, which distinguishes it from the motorcycle fleet. Fat tyres here are a styling and comfort choice for summer cruising, not winter capability.

items.name: Juiced Scrambler Electric Bike
items.description: Moto-style fat-tire electric bike, no specialised licence required.

name: Rolling Freedom Motorcycles & Lake Tahoe Slingshots
note: No human-powered bicycles anywhere in the fleet. Every two-wheeler on the site is either a licensed motorcycle or an electric bike, and the electric bikes are recorded under electric_transport per the power-source routing rule. The Pass A road_cycling hint came from generic bike wording.
